name: Sika Rugasol MH
paste:
SIKA® RUGASOL® MH: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Rugasol® MH, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sika_rugasol_mh.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Rugasol® MH where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Rugasol® MH is a surface retarder used mainly for on site exposed aggregate work. Sika® Rugasol® MH surface retarder is used to expose aggregate on formed Portland cement based concrete surfaces, both vertical and horizontal.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Rugasol® MH provides an efficient, economical method of obtaining a rough bonding surface without the need of hacking, chipping or sandblasting. It can be painted directly onto formwork for:
    - Walls
    - Ceilings
    - Vertical construction joints
    - Precast panel
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Rugasol® MH
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Concrete surface retarder for horizontal and vertical surfaces
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika® Rugasol® MH dries on the formwork to form a tough, water-insoluble, abrasion resistant film. It is not affected by light foot traffic or by light showers. Forms may be coated before or after erection. Reinforcing steel is placed as usual.
    - The depth of retardation depends upon the thickness of the coating, the time elapsed before the retarder is removed, the cement content and the quantity of water in the mix. The ambient temperature will also affect the depth of retardation.
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer - Advantages.
    - It can provide a decorative architectural finish to precast or insitu concrete surfaces.
    - Can be applied to most type of clean formwork such as steel, timber, plywood, etc.
    - Can be used in conjunction with Rugasol® C to provide constant aggregate exposure to both vertical and horizontal surfaces.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Solvent base emulsion
    - Appearance and colour: Pale red liquid
    - Density: 1.05 kg/litre approx.
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Yield: 4 – 5 m²/litre/coat
    - Ambient air temperature: 10°C – 30°C
2.7 Specific advice. For optimum results forms should be removed as soon as possible after the concrete is poured. Normally two days in warm weather and up to 3 days in cold weather. If the forms must remain in place longer, use two or even three coats of Sika® Rugasol® MH to ensure deep penetration. A sample slab should be made first to see if the effect given is that which is required. Some of the soft cement paste will stick to the forms when shuttering is stripped. This can be removed, while still soft, by a light wire-brushing or with a high pressure water jet. Always clean off immediately after stripping the shutters as the soft cement paste soon hardens. The concrete should be kept moist and cured as usual. In special conditions ie. high cement contents, very hot weather etc., consult our Technical department. It is advisable to undertake a small test in all cases prior to use, as cements and conditions of use can change from site to site. When using untreated wood and porous forms for the first time we recommend a minimum of two coats of Sika® Rugasol® MH. This will impregnate the surface and aid in uniform exposure of the aggregates. Depth of Etch: 3-5mm approx.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 205 litre drum, 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: 1 year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application. Sika® Rugasol® MH is ready to use straight from the container. It should be stirred before use and must not be diluted. Sika® Rugasol® MH can be applied to any type of clean form. Apply a heavy coat with a brush or roller, and allow to dry (normally 2 to 4 hours). Brushes and equipment can be cleaned before the material hardens, using Sika Colma Cleaner. Mould oils should not be used on the forms. Coated surfaces should be protected from strong sunlight.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Sika® Rugasol® MH, and Sika Colma Cleaner contain solvents and are flammable, keep away from sparks, flames, etc.
    - Always keep the lid on Sika® Rugasol® MH containers when not in use.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Rugasol® MH, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sika_rugasol_mh.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Rugasol MH, version 29/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/MSDS%20Rugasol%C2%AE%20MH%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
